## What Are Quarto Listings?

> **Quarto Listings** automatically generate structured, index-style collections (such as project feeds, blog posts, case studies, or notes) from Quarto documents or metadata. Instead of manually maintaining links and summaries in multiple places, a listing can pull titles, dates, categories/tags, descriptions, and reading times dynamically.

## How to Use Listings on a Portfolio Site

- **Organize work by topic:**
  - Tag entries by tool or theme (e.g., `R`, `SQL`, `GA4`, `Case-31`, `CEP`) so visitors can scan what you built.
- **Keep a landing feed:**
  - Use a `grid`, `default`, or `table` listing layout to spotlight recent analyses or coursework artifacts cleanly.
- **Scale without clutter:**
  - Add new `.qmd` or `.md` items to a folder and let the listing update automatically on render.

## Example Portfolio Index Table

| Artifact | Topic / Tags | Purpose |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| Home Profile | `Portfolio`, `MSDM` | Bio, education, skills, and career goals |
| CEP & Case 31 Portal | `CEP`, `Case-31`, `Analytics` | Culminating project & analytical framework |
| CSS & SCSS Guide | `Quarto`, `CSS`, `SCSS` | Visual customization approach |
